Ya un ki aisi aankhein hain jin se woh dekhein, ya aise kaan jin se woh sunein? Agar woh yeh sab nahin kar sakte, to tum un ki ibadat kaise karte ho, un se faide ki umeed rakhte hue ya apne aap ko nuqsan se bachane ke liye? Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: 'Apne thehraye hue sharikon ko sab ko mila kar pukaro, aur mere khilaaf jo chaal chalna chaho chalo, aur mujhe koi mohlat na do.'
196: 'Be-shak mera kaar-saaz Allah hai, jo mujhe mehfooz rakhta hai, is liye mujhe Us ke siwa kisi ki zaroorat nahin. Mujhe tumhare buton se koi dar nahin, kyunke Allah ne kitab logon ki hidayat ke liye utari hai; aur Wohi hai jo apni makhlooq mein se neik logon ki hifazat karta hai, unhein mehfooz rakhta hai aur un ki madad karta hai.'
197: Aey mushriko, in buton mein se jinhein tum pukarte ho, woh na tumhari madad kar sakte hain aur na apni. Woh to bilkul be-bas hain aur kuch nahin kar sakte. Phir tum Allah ko pukarne ke bajaye unhein kaise pukarte ho?
198: Aur agar tum apne un buton ko, jinhein tum Allah ke bajaye poojte ho, seedhe raaste aur sabit-qadmi ki taraf bulao, to woh tumhari pukar sun hi nahin sakenge. Aur tum unhein dekhte ho ke woh apni banayi hui aankhon se tumhari taraf dekh rahe hain, halanke woh aisi cheezein hain jo dekh nahin saktin! Woh insaano aur jaanwaron ki shakl mein buton ke haath, paon aur aankhein banaya karte the, magar woh sirf be-jaan cheezein theen, jo hil bhi nahin sakti theen.
199: Aey Rasool, logon se woh qabool kar lijiye jo woh kar sakte hain, yani woh amal aur chalan jo un ke liye aasan ho, aur un se aisi baatein na maangiye jo un ke liye bahut mushkil hon, kyunke isi se woh door bhaagenge. Aur unhein hukm dijiye ke khoobsurat baat karein aur neik kaam karein, aur un logon se munh mod lijiye jo nadani karte hain, aur un ki na-waaqfiyat ka saamna un hi jaise andaaz mein na kijiye. Jo aap ko takleef de, use takleef na dijiye; aur jo aap se kuch roke, us se na rokiye.
200: Aur aey Rasool, agar aap mehsoos karein ke shaytan aap ke dil mein koi buri baat daal raha hai ya aap ko bhalai se rok raha hai, to Allah se panaah maangiye aur Usi ki panaah mein aaiye. Woh aap ki har baat sunta hai, aur jab aap panaah maangte hain to aap se khabardar hai, aur Woh aap ko us se bachayega.
201: Jo log Allah se darte hain, Us ke hukm par chalte hain aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachte hain, jab un ke paas shaytan ki taraf se koi buri baat aati hai ke kuch galat karein, to unhein Allah ki azmat yaad aa jati hai, aur zaalimon ke liye Us ka azaab aur ehsan karne walon ke liye Us ka ajr. Chunanche woh apni nafarmani se baaz aa jate hain, Allah ki taraf tauba karte hue magfirat maangte hain, taake durust kaam karein; aur unhein saaf nazar aa jata hai ke woh kya galat kar rahe the, aur woh us se ruk jate hain.
202: Aur shaytanon ke bhai, jo be-haayi karte hain aur kufr karte hain, unhein shaytan aur bari gumraahi mein kheench le jate hain: woh ek ke baad ek gunah karte chale jate hain. Woh apni koshish mein kabhi nahin rukte: na shaytan apni gumraahi mein, aur na woh be-haaya log jo un ke peeche chalte hain aur burai karte hain.
203: Aur aey Rasool, agar aap koi nishani le aayein to woh use rad kar dete hain aur us se munh mod lete hain; aur agar aap un ke paas koi nishani na laayein, to woh poochte hain ke aap ne koi nishani kyun nahin banayi. Aey Rasool, in se keh dijiye: 'Yeh mere ikhtiyar mein nahin ke main jab chahoon koi nishani le aaoon. Balke main sirf us ki pairvi karta hoon jo Allah ki taraf se mujh par wahi ki jati hai: yeh Quran jo main tumhein padh kar sunata hoon, jo Allah ki taraf se daleel aur suboot hai, jo tumhara Khaaliq aur tumhari zindagi chalane wala hai, aur apni makhlooq mein se mominon ke liye hidayat aur rehmat hai. Aur jo log iman nahin rakhte, woh gumraah aur bad-naseeb hain.'
204: Aur jab Quran padha jaye, to use gaur se suno: baat na karo aur apne aap ko kisi aur kaam mein na lagao, taake Allah tum par reham kare.
205: Aur apne Rubb Allah ko yaad karo, aajizi ke saath, Us ke saamne jhuk kar, aur dar aur haibat ke saath. Aur Use miyaana aawaz mein pukaro, bahut buland aawaz se nahin, din ke shuru aur us ke aakhir mein, in waqton ki khaas khoobiyon ki wajah se, aur un logon mein se na ho jao jo Allah Buland ki yaad se gaafil hain.
206: Jo farishte aap ke Rubb ke paas hain, woh Us ki ibadat se kabhi gurur mein nahin aate, paak hai Woh. Balke woh poori lagan se ibadat mein lage rehte hain, kabhi nahin thakte, din-raat Us ki paaki bayan karte hain aur Use sajda karte hain.
